answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 54 POA per identity, released only after 11 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 700 fakes must lock 37800 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. A terrace of doubt is healthy, a ledge of proof is required, and a nectar of patience is the price of a clean panel.
